description_en: Saves the LLM Wiki (OKF) switch and automatic execution schedule for a standard enterprise knowledge base, and returns the saved configuration and task status
description_zh: 完整保存普通企业知识库的 LLM Wiki（OKF）开关与自动执行计划，并返回保存后的配置和任务状态
name: UpdateKnowledgeBaseSmartIndexConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The platform application credential. Pass this parameter when using the application proxy mode, and specify the operator by using opsUserId or opsUserCode based on the application configuration. Do not use real credentials in logs or public examples
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用凭证。使用应用代理模式时传入，并根据应用配置配合 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定操作人；请勿在日志或公开示例中使用真实凭证
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proxied WINNEXO platform user. This parameter is used only when the identity mapping mode of the application credential is winnexo_uid. You cannot use this parameter to bypass tenant or knowledge base permission verification
parameters.help_zh: 被代理的 WINNEXO 平台用户 ID。仅在应用凭证的身份映射模式为 winnexo_uid 时使用；不能用该参数绕过租户或知识库权限校验
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique code of the proxied user within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the identity mapping mode of the application credential is source_uid. You cannot use this parameter to bypass tenant or knowledge base permission verification
parameters.help_zh: 被代理用户在租户内的唯一编码。仅在应用凭证的身份映射模式为 source_uid 时使用；不能用该参数绕过租户或知识库权限校验
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target tenant. This parameter is used for tenant routing in public requests. The server-side authentication chain verifies access permissions based on this parameter. You cannot use this parameter to access unauthorized tenants
parameters.help_zh: 目标租户 ID，用于公共请求的租户路由，由服务端鉴权链校验访问权限；不能据此访问未授权租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the root directory for the standard enterprise knowledge base of the current tenant. You can obtain this ID from the response of the CreateTenantDirectory operation. You cannot use the internal primary key of the directory, or the IDs of personal spaces, group knowledge bases, subdirectories, or special knowledge bases
parameters.help_zh: 当前租户普通企业知识库根目录的业务 ID，可从 CreateTenantDirectory 创建响应获取。不能使用目录内部主键、个人空间、群知识库、子目录或特殊知识库的 ID
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The revision obtained from the most recent configuration read. This value must be a non-negative integer. The value is 0 when not configured, and increments by 1 after a successful save. If the version does not match, ERR.SmartIndex.Conflict is returned. You must read the configuration again before saving. This field is not an idempotency key
parameters.help_zh: 最近一次读取配置所得的 revision，必须为非负整数。未配置时为 0；保存成功后版本加 1。版本不匹配返回 ERR.SmartIndex.Conflict，应重新读取后再保存；该字段不是幂等键
parameters.name: expected_revision

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the LLM Wiki smart index. Valid values:
true: Enabled. Switching from disabled to enabled creates an asynchronous full build task and a bill.
false: Disabled. If artifacts exist, asynchronous cleanup is initiated.
You cannot toggle the switch during task execution, and you cannot re-enable it until cleanup is complete
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启 LLM Wiki 智能索引。true 开启；从关闭切换为开启时会创建异步全量构建任务和账单。false 关闭，有产物时进入异步清理。任务执行期间不能切换开关，清理完成前不能重新开启
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The automatic execution schedule. Use a five-part cron expression where the minute field must be 0. For example, 0 2 * * * indicates execution at 02:00 every day based on the timezone. Omitting this parameter, setting it to null, or using a blank string indicates manual execution and clears the old automatic schedule, but does not disable the smart index. Maximum length: 100 characters
parameters.help_zh: 自动执行计划，使用五段 Cron 表达式且分钟位必须为 0，例如 0 2 * * * 表示按 timezone 每天 02:00 执行。省略、null 或空白字符串表示手动执行，会清除旧的自动计划，但不等于关闭智能索引；最多 100 个字符
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.help_en: The IANA time zone name used for the execution schedule. Default value: Asia/Shanghai. If this parameter is omitted, set to null, or left as a blank string, the default value is used. The length of a non-empty value must be 1 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 执行计划使用的 IANA 时区名称，默认 Asia/Shanghai。省略、null 或空白字符串均使用该默认值；非空值长度为 1–64 个字符
parameters.name: timezone

schema.description_en: The smart index configuration for the enterprise knowledge base
schema.description_zh: 更新企业知识库智能索引配置

artifacts.description_en: The references to published smart index artifacts. This value is empty if no artifacts are available or if the feature is disabled. Internal storage credentials are not included
artifacts.description_zh: 已发布的智能索引产物引用；尚无可用产物或已关闭时为空，不包含内部存储凭据

knowledgeInsights.description_en: The resource reference for knowledge insights. This value is empty if the artifact is not yet available
knowledgeInsights.description_zh: 知识洞察的资源引用；该产物尚不可用时为空

sourceId.description_en: The business ID of the knowledge insights resource
sourceId.description_zh: 知识洞察的资源业务 ID

topicCards.description_en: The reference to the directory where topic cards are located. This value is empty if the artifact is not yet available
topicCards.description_zh: 主题卡片所在目录的引用；该产物尚不可用时为空

directoryId.description_en: The business ID of the topic card artifact directory
directoryId.description_zh: 主题卡片产物目录的业务 ID

topicGraph.description_en: The resource reference for the topic graph. This value is empty if the artifact is not yet available
topicGraph.description_zh: 主题关系图的资源引用；该产物尚不可用时为空

sourceId.description_en: The business ID of the topic graph resource
sourceId.description_zh: 主题关系图的资源业务 ID

topicOverview.description_en: The resource reference for the topic overview. This value is empty if the artifact is not yet available
topicOverview.description_zh: 主题概览的资源引用；该产物尚不可用时为空

sourceId.description_en: The business ID of the topic overview resource
sourceId.description_zh: 主题概览的资源业务 ID

billingId.description_en: The bill ID of the current or most recent task. This value is empty if no corresponding task exists. The existence of a bill ID does not indicate that the deduction is complete
billingId.description_zh: 当前或最近任务的账单标识；没有相应任务时为空，存在标识不代表已经完成扣费

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. If the request fails, a specific business error code is returned
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，成功为 200；失败时为具体业务错误码

directoryId.description_en: The business ID of the root directory for the enterprise knowledge base. Subsequent configuration operations use this ID
directoryId.description_zh: 企业知识库根目录的业务 ID，后续配置接口使用此标识

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the LLM Wiki smart index is currently enabled. This parameter indicates the configuration switch status and does not indicate whether the build task is complete
enabled.description_zh: 当前是否开启 LLM Wiki 智能索引；表示配置开关，不表示构建任务已经完成

lastError.description_en: The description of the most recent configuration or scan error. This value is empty if no error occurred
lastError.description_zh: 最近一次配置或扫描错误说明；没有错误时为空

lastSuccessTaskId.description_en: The business ID of the most recent successful build task. This value is empty if no successful task exists
lastSuccessTaskId.description_zh: 最近一次成功构建任务的业务标识；尚无成功任务时为空

lifecycle.description_en:
The configuration lifecycle. Valid values:
DISABLED: Disabled.
ENABLED: Enabled.
DISABLING: Artifacts are being cleaned up after disabling
lifecycle.description_zh: 配置生命周期：DISABLED 表示已关闭，ENABLED 表示已开启，DISABLING 表示关闭后的产物正在清理

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful. If the request fails, this parameter describes the cause of the error
message.description_zh: 响应消息，成功时为 success；失败时用于说明错误原因

requestId.description_en: The request tracking ID. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues related to this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求追踪标识，可用于定位本次调用的问题

revision.description_en: The current configuration version. Submit this value as expectedRevision during the next update. The value is 0 when not configured, and increments by 1 after each successful save
revision.description_zh: 当前配置版本，下一次更新时作为 expectedRevision 提交。未配置时为 0，每次成功保存后加 1

schedule.description_en: The automatic execution schedule. An empty cronExpression indicates manual execution
schedule.description_zh: 自动执行计划；cronExpression 为空表示手动执行

cronExpression.description_en: The current five-part cron automatic execution schedule. An empty value indicates manual execution
cronExpression.description_zh: 当前五段 Cron 自动执行计划；为空时表示手动执行

nextRunAt.description_en: The next scheduled execution time in ISO 8601 format. This value is empty when no automatic schedule is configured
nextRunAt.description_zh: 下次计划执行时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式；无自动计划时为空

timezone.description_en: The IANA time zone name for the execution schedule. Default value: Asia/Shanghai when not configured
timezone.description_zh: 执行计划的 IANA 时区名称，未配置时默认为 Asia/Shanghai

targetDirId.description_en: The business ID of the smart index artifact directory. This value is empty if no artifact directory exists or if the feature is disabled
targetDirId.description_zh: 智能索引产物目录的业务 ID；尚无产物目录或已关闭时为空

task.description_en: The status of the task generated by this save operation, or the current or most recent task status returned by the read operation. This value is empty if no corresponding task exists
task.description_zh: 本次保存产生的任务状态，或读取接口返回的当前或最近任务状态；没有相应任务时为空

billingId.description_en: The bill ID corresponding to the task. The existence of a bill ID does not indicate that the deduction is complete
billingId.description_zh: 该任务对应的账单标识；存在账单标识不代表已经完成扣费

billingStatus.description_en: The billing status of the task. For example, PENDING indicates that settlement is not complete, and ENDED indicates that the billing process has ended. This status is returned separately from the task execution status
billingStatus.description_zh: 任务计费状态，例如 PENDING 表示尚未完成结算，ENDED 表示计费流程已结束；与任务执行状态分别返回

executionStatus.description_en: The execution status of the task. For example, QUEUED indicates that the task is queued, RUNNING indicates that the task is running, SUCCEEDED indicates that the task succeeded, and FAILED indicates that the task failed. Evaluate the build result based on the task status. A successful configuration save does not indicate a successful task
executionStatus.description_zh: 任务执行状态，例如 QUEUED 表示已入队、RUNNING 表示执行中、SUCCEEDED 表示成功、FAILED 表示失败。应结合任务状态判断构建结果，不能以配置保存成功代替任务成功

gmtCreate.description_en: The time when the task was created, in ISO 8601 format
gmtCreate.description_zh: 任务创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

gmtModified.description_en: The time when the task was updated, in ISO 8601 format
gmtModified.description_zh: 任务更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

lastError.description_en: The description of the most recent task error. This value is empty if no error occurred
lastError.description_zh: 最近一次任务错误说明；没有错误时为空

operation.description_en:
The operation type of the smart index task. Valid values:
full: Full build.
incremental: Incremental update
operation.description_zh: 智能索引任务操作类型：full 表示全量构建，incremental 表示增量更新

progress.description_en: The execution progress reported by the task. This value is empty if the task has not yet reported progress
progress.description_zh: 任务报告的执行进度；任务尚未提供进度时为空

reportStatus.description_en: The reporting status of the task result. For example, pending indicates that the result is waiting to be reported, and not_required indicates that reporting is not required
reportStatus.description_zh: 任务结果上报状态，例如 pending 表示等待上报，not_required 表示无需上报

reused.description_en: Indicates whether an existing task was reused. The value is false if no task was reused
reused.description_zh: 是否复用了已有任务，未复用时为 false

taskKey.description_en: The business ID of the smart index task
taskKey.description_zh: 智能索引任务的业务标识

triggerType.description_en:
The trigger type of the task. Valid values:
manual: Manually triggered.
scheduled: Triggered by an automatic schedule.
The build task generated upon the first enabling uses manual
triggerType.description_zh: 任务触发类型：manual 表示手动触发，scheduled 表示自动计划触发。首次开启产生的构建任务使用 manual

usageComplete.description_en: Indicates whether the task usage statistics are complete. This status is independent of the task execution status and billing status
usageComplete.description_zh: 任务用量统计是否完整，独立于任务执行状态和计费状态
